items.title: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
items.summary: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.

items.title: 一句简单的提示词就可以让Claude更积极地合并重复代码 但这也是有代价的...
items.summary:
A 社在 Claude Fable 5.2 的提示词指南中提到：在编程任务中只要告诉模型「你是这个代码库的长期维护者」，模型处理重复代码和顺手修复相关问题的积极性就会明显提高。
